law: REGISTRATION of E-Q35 — DEPTH-2 CONDITIONAL AXES (ORCH-R28 lane T19-a, the r24 ideas battery I-3, the LAST unrun idea from that battery): the question map as a PROGRAM. Stage-1 (the sealed E-Q22 noul profiles) measured each record's 8-axis mass; stage-2 questions now EMBED that measured state in their instructions — naming the record's own top/bottom axes and (in the full arm) their measured values — and ask RELATION questions about them (subordination, independence, provenance, boundary, polarity, family-edge). If verdicts track the embedded measurements, the map is not just a fixed battery but a two-stage instrument whose second stage consumes the first stage's outputs: embedding-as-program.
provenance_of_the_question: The r24 ideas battery I-3 (novelty 4 / feasibility 3.5): 'a second noul battery whose state embeds stage-1's measured profile — embedding-as-program, targeting the E-Q22 miss table.' Deferred twice (r25 ran I-1; r26 ran I-5; r27 ran I-6). QA-Emb (arXiv:2405.16714) uses fixed question sets as features; conditioning the QUESTION TEXT on the embedder's own measured outputs is the unoccupied move.

design_frozen.substrate: The frozen 8-record subset (N1,N3,P1,P3,Q1,Q3,A1,A3 — the E-Q23/E-Q34 subset) with their sealed E-Q22 noul profiles as stage-1 state.
design_frozen.relation_questions: Per record, SIX questions built by an EXPLICIT loop from the stage-1 profile: Q1 SUBORDINATION (top axis vs second axis: 'does [top] subordinate [second] — does [second] only execute what [top] delivers?'); Q2 INDEPENDENCE (top vs bottom: 'does [top] operate independently of [bottom]?'); Q3 PROVENANCE (top: 'is [top]'s presence carried by the record's explicit mechanism rather than its framing?'); Q4 BOUNDARY (the axis nearest 0.5: 'is [boundary-axis] genuinely ambiguous in this record, or settled?'); Q5 POLARITY (top: 'is [top] load-bearing (removing it breaks the record) or incidental?'); Q6 FAMILY-EDGE ('does the record sit at the boundary of its family label or deep inside it?'). All typed noul, criteria true/false per the map's standard shape.
design_frozen.arm_C_full_conditional: 8 records x 1 batched call. Instructions NAME the record's specific axes AND embed their sealed stage-1 values (e.g. 'Stage-1 measured non-local coupling at 0.93 and local-rule physics at 0.07.').
design_frozen.arm_N_named_no_values: 8 records x 1 batched call. Instructions NAME the same specific axes but NOT the values ('Stage-1 identified non-local coupling and local-rule physics as this record's top and second concerns.') — isolates the VALUE-EMBEDDING variable from axis-naming.
design_frozen.stability: 3 records re-embedded once per arm (-stab suffix) — the F5 pattern.
design_frozen.measures: M1 THE PROGRAM TEST: Spearman(p_C(Q1 subordination), stage-1 dominance |top1-top2|) over the 8 records — do verdicts track the embedded measurements? M2 THE CONDITIONING DELTA: per paired question, |p_C - p_N| — how much does telling the model its own measurements move the verdict (premise-innocence or premise-contamination)? M3 THE RELATION SIGNATURE: do the 6 relation masses separate the 4 families (max family-gap per relation) — is the A-family (the ternary miss-table family) better separated by RELATIONS than by raw mass? M4 stability of both arms.

floors.F1: the six relation templates + the two arm preamble templates frozen here, byte-identical construction by explicit loop (the T5-a guard law)
floors.F2: stage-1 values cited in arm C instructions are the sealed E-Q22 values only, rounded to 2 decimals, unedited
floors.F3: one batched call per record per arm, all 6 answers present, p in [0,1]
floors.F4: the family-separation comparison against the sealed E-Q22 profiles (the same 8 records)

hypotheses.H1_program: Spearman(p_C(Q1), |top1-top2|) >= 0.5 — the map functions as a program: measured inputs in, consistent verdicts out
hypotheses.H2_premise_innocence: |p_C - p_N| <= 0.10 on >= 75% of the 48 paired questions — OR DIES as the contamination receipt (either direction is a finding)
hypotheses.H3_relation_signature: family separation of the best relation question > family separation of the best raw axis on the A-family records — the A signature is a RELATION, not a mass
hypotheses.C33: the question map is programmable — stage-2 verdicts track embedded stage-1 state (H1) without premise contamination beyond the drift band (H2); LIVES iff H1 AND H2

predictions.P1: Spearman in [0.5, 0.8] — the subordination verdict tracks dominance but noisily (relations are harder than concerns)
predictions.P2: the conditioning delta concentrates on Q4 BOUNDARY and Q6 FAMILY-EDGE (the questions about uncertainty) — value-embedding moves the uncertain questions, not the mechanical ones
predictions.P3: A-family records separate on Q1 SUBORDINATION (allocation subordinates physics) better than on any raw axis — the miss-table prediction
predictions.P4: arm stability replicates the standing band (max <= 0.10)
predictions.P5: at least one record shows a C-N flip (a relation verdict that inverts when the values are shown) — the contamination ceiling

falsifier: ANY of F1-F5 breached; a relation template edited after registration; stage-1 values transcribed from anywhere but the sealed E-Q22 file; the Spearman computed on anything but the 8 frozen records.
budget: 19 typesafe calls (8 + 8 + 3 stability). Part of the r28 round budget.
